title: Factory Droid client <-> daemon protocol (droid)
description: The droid (CLI) <-> client surface: every droid.* request, response and notification frame. References shared.schema.json. Generated from the Zod schemas in @factory/droid-sdk-core. Every distinct protocol schema is a definition, named after its most upstream export; reference one with #/definitions/<Name>. Request definitions carry x-factory-response (and/or x-factory-result) naming their response definition. Wire frames are expressed as allOf: [{$ref: JsonRpcEnvelopeSchema}, {frame-specific properties}]. Values marked x-factory-runtime-only are validated more strictly at runtime than this document can express.

geminiThoughtSignature.description: @deprecated Use thinking block `signature` fields with `signatureProvider: "google"` instead. Do not use in new code.

computerId.description: ID of the droid computer the automation runs on. Remote automations require computerId or computerName.

computerName.description: Name of the droid computer the automation runs on, resolved to its ID at creation time (use ListComputers to see available names). Remote automations require computerId or computerName; if the name matches multiple computers, ask the user which one to use and retry with its computerId.

executionLocation.description: Where the automation runs: "local" creates a local filesystem automation on this machine; "remote" creates a cloud automation that runs on a droid computer.

executionTemplateId.description: ID of the Execution Template used to provision a fresh Computer for every remote automation run.

memory_instruction.description: Optional memory guidance, folded into the run prompt as a "## Memory & Evolution" section.

model.description: Optional model for run sessions. Accepts a model id, a model display name, or "cheapest" to pin the lowest-cost available model (good for mechanical scheduled work). Names are resolved against the live model catalog; an unrecognized name fails with the available models listed. Omit to use the default model. A pin the run target cannot resolve falls back to the default at run time.

prompt.description: Agent instructions to run on each scheduled tick.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning effort for run sessions (e.g. "low", "medium", "high"). Unsupported values are clamped to the model default at run time. Omit to use the model default.

schedule.description: A 5-field cron expression for local automations, or a 5-field cron expression/natural-language cadence for remote automations.

status.description: Initial status. Use "paused" when creating an automation for a draft Software Factory workstream.

tags.description: Optional tags stored on the remote automation, used for grouping and lifecycle linkage (e.g. "sf-workstream:<id>" ties the automation to a Software Factory workstream so workstream deletion removes it). Remote automations only.

visualization_instruction.description: Optional visualization guidance, folded into the run prompt as a "## Visualization" section.

workstreamId.description: Optional Software Factory workstream id. Set this when the automation is created as part of a workstream so it stays linked to that workstream.
